environment.description: Same Terraform state backend on ECS Fargate behind ALB. AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached to the ALB with a custom rate-based rule (threshold: 5 requests per 5-minute window per IP for /v1/state path with distinct query string values) combined with a custom regex pattern set rule that inspects the workspace_id query parameter and blocks requests where the numeric value falls outside the pre-registered workspace ID allocation range for the source IP's mapped organization (maintained via a DynamoDB lookup in a WAF custom response integration using AWS WAFv2 Intelligent Threat Mitigation with ATP credential stuffing signal correlation). The WebACL also includes AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING in COUNT mode and a label-based cross-rule evaluation that promotes to BLOCK when combined with the rate signal.

waf_rules.name: OrgWorkspaceIDEnforcement
waf_rules.description: Cross-references workspace_id parameter against per-org allocation table via IP-to-org mapping. Blocks access to workspace IDs not allocated to the requesting organization.
waf_rules.backing_store: DynamoDB table org-workspace-allocations with IP-range to org-id mapping and org-id to workspace-id-range mapping

waf_rules.name: StateEnumerationRateLimit
waf_rules.scope_down: URI path /v1/state with varying query strings

config.auth: OAuth2 proxy sidecar sets X-Authenticated-Org header
config.network: Private subnet, ALB in public subnet
